SEARCH
Module io.github.jpersist.tools.api
Package persistence.tools.spi

Interface SchemaExporterFactory

All Superinterfaces:
PersistenceServiceProvider
public interface SchemaExporterFactory extends PersistenceServiceProvider
Service Provider Interface (SPI) factory for creating SchemaExporter instances capable of generating offline DDL scripts at build time.

Implementations are discovered at runtime through the ServiceLoader mechanism. Each implementation declares the persistence namespace it supports (e.g. "javax" for JPA 2.x or "jakarta" for JPA 3.x) so that the correct schema export strategy can be resolved for the target JPA specification version.

In JPMS environments, provider modules register their implementation with provides persistence.tools.spi.SchemaExporterFactory in module-info.java.

Usage Example


 SchemaExporterFactory factory = SchemaExporterFactory.newSchemaExporterFactory("3.1");
 SchemaExporter exporter = factory.newSchemaExporter(
     List.of("com.example.model.Customer", "com.example.model.Order"),
     Map.of("hibernate.dialect", "org.hibernate.dialect.PostgreSQLDialect",
            "hibernate.format_sql", "true")
 );
 exporter.export(SchemaExporter.Action.BOTH, new File("build/schema/ddl.sql"));

4.2.0
